lines.text: Moses says to return a brother's straying ox or sheep, and to help lift his fallen donkey or ox.
Moses says to let the mother bird go, and to put a railing around a new roof.
When a husband falsely accuses his wife, her brothers bring proof to the elders, and he is fined a hundred shekels of silver.

wrong_details.wrong: her brothers bring proof to the elders
wrong_details.true: her father and mother bring the proof to the city elders

lines.text: A betrothed woman in the city who does not cry out is stoned with the man, but in the open country only the man dies.
A man who seizes an unpledged virgin must pay her father fifty shekels and serve him seven years, and no man may marry his father's wife.

wrong_details.true: must marry her and never divorce her
